additional_info.subject: RE: ID0476218-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP/S7170003860] Authentication Sync Issue CRM:03289000444
additional_info.body:
Dear
Laurenz
,
Following your request and after our checks, the first point we can confirm is that the card terminal is not configured as one of the payment options in the outlet configuration.
After reviewing the logs and matching the relevant timestamps, we were able to confirm that an authentication error did occur, as shown in the attached screenshot. However, this error is no longer active and appears to have been a temporary issue, possibly caused by a system bug.
At this stage, no active errors are detected. We will continue to monitor the charger closely, and if the issue appears again, we will take the necessary actions to resolve it
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
